card.name: "Because" giving reasons for restrictions
card.fires_on: The word "because" (sometimes "due" or "either") that opens a reason clause. It is strongest after "either" in label text about when a route or drug is restricted or reserved.

modes.label: Reason after patient risk
modes.description: "because" or "due" giving the reason a patient is a poor candidate or cannot comply.
modes.example: In patients who cannot comply with dosing instructions<< due>> to mental disability, therapy with FOS
